article_facts: fact:item: Wolf Vine Golem is a 2-cost Nature creature card with 3 attack and 3 defense, described as a flexible card for Nature decks. | Wolf Vine Golem is an incredibly flexible and efficient 2-cost creature (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=193)

fact:npc: Frostfang Wolves are white wolves that roam the slopes around Snowhill and are more aggressive inside the caverns. | The Frostfang Wolf is the most legendary. These white wolves prowl the slopes around Snowhill. (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=75)

fact:mechanic: Wolf Vine Golem gives its controller an extra star in every battle involving it, enabling stronger star tricks a turn earlier. | The first gives you an extra star in every battle involving him. (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=193)

fact:mechanic: Wolf Vine Golem has a power-up ability: matching a yellow gem lets it take revenge on the creature that defeated it in combat, stunning that creature. | Just match that yellow gem ... and have your revenge on the creature with the nerve to beat you in combat. (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=193)
